```{r}
# 0. 加载包与数据
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```


```{r}
listings_clean <- readRDS("listings_clean.rds")
```


```{r}
listings_clean <- listings_clean |>
  mutate(room_type = factor(room_type))


# 1. 箱线图：价格如何随房型变化
ggplot(listings_clean,
       aes(x = room_type, y = price, fill = room_type)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Price by Room Type",
    x = "Room Type",
    y = "Price (£)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
# 2
price_summary <- listings_clean |>
  group_by(room_type) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(price)),
    mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(price_summary, digits = 2)

```
# 3. 显著性检验：不同房型平均价格有无显著差异
# 沿用 Lab 5：排除 Shared room，只比较两组

```{r}

listings_subset <- listings_clean |>
  filter(room_type %in%
           c("Entire home/apt", "Private room")) |>
  droplevels()

# Welch 独立样本 t 检验
t_result <- t.test(
  price ~ room_type,
  data = listings_subset
)

print(t_result)
```

```{r}
aov(price ~ room_type, data = listings_clean) |> summary()
```

对每个value进行了解释说明

```{r}
lm(price ~ room_type, data= listings_clean) |> summary()
```

# 4. 计算价格与评分之间的 Pearson 相关系数
# 排除缺失值，确保两个变量的数据完整

```{r}

cor_data <- listings_clean |>
  drop_na(price, review_scores_rating)

correlation <- cor(
  cor_data$price,
  cor_data$review_scores_rating,
  method = "pearson"
)

print(correlation)
```

# 5. 统计显著性

```{r}
cor_result <- cor.test(
  cor_data$price,
  cor_data$review_scores_rating,
  method = "pearson"
)

print(cor_result)
```


```{r}


```


# 6. 结果解释
# 相关系数及 p 值

```{r}
cat("Correlation:", round(correlation, 4), "\n")
cat("P-value:", cor_result$p.value, "\n")

if (cor_result$p.value < 0.05) {
  print("Statistically significant correlation")
} else {
  print("Correlation is not statistically significant")
}
```
